content.short: Friktion is a cryptocurrency portfolio management platform designed to perform across market cycles.
content.description: Friktion is a comprehensive platform for full‑stack portfolio management designed to outperform market cycles. It provides strategies aimed at risk‑adjusted returns for DAOs, individuals, and traditional institutions. Friktion’s built‑in portfolio approaches are called volts. Volts are chosen by users based on their risk tolerance and deposited assets, and each generates passive returns. With Friktion, you can assemble a portfolio intended to produce gains in bull, bear, and crab markets.
content.meta: Friktion is a one-stop shop for full-stack portfolio management to outperform market cycles. Discover Friktion and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
